summary: Riverside kerb backing onto bush, a row of cars parked, homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto riverbank bush and path
Many cars park along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a riverside path behind the kerb; nearest dwelling about 26 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb alongside the lane where cars already park; no pull-off, but parked-car row shows room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Row of cars parked along this kerb in both images; 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Signs: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; No Stopping Any Time at both ends
Low-lying: 6-9 m elevation, Brisbane River 127 m away
Steep: about 2% at best section, under 3%
sun_shade: Open to afternoon sun from the west; riverbank trees give some shade from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the 2P signs are enforced overnight

best_section.where: The Esplanade east kerb, bend with riverbank bush behind, past the 50 m marker
